source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with layered ink-wash mountains, misty river flats, wooded rocky banks, small villages, tiny boats, bridges, and willow/pine vegetation. Seals, calligraphy, borders, and blank paper are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_needle_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant upper central mountain: steep craggy peak with attached dark ridges, pale side slopes, and small pine clusters along the crest and ledges.
must_preserve: dry-brush contour lines on the vertical cliffs
layered ink washes forming rounded ridges
dark textured strokes in the ravines
tiny crest pines and dotted foliage
soft mist transitions at the mountain foot

motifs.name: upper_mist_river_flats
motifs.description: Isolate the broad upper river plain beneath the mountains, including low horizontal shorelines, marshy banks, faint tree rows, small bridge-like crossing, and tiny boat/mast marks.
must_preserve: thin horizontal waterline brushwork
pale wash edges fading into mist
small dark reed and tree dots
delicate bridge or crossing strokes near the center
broken dry-brush texture on exposed shoals

motifs.name: right_terraced_hillside_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-right rocky hillside and riverbank with terraced paths, pine groves, small roofed structures, and layered slope washes.
must_preserve: angular roof geometry of the small buildings
dark pine trunks and clustered needle marks
stepped terrace lines along the slope
rounded rock texture with gray wash
pale peach accents on walls and roofs

motifs.name: central_wooded_islet_house
motifs.description: Isolate the central rocky islet: rounded boulders, dense vertical pines, grasses, and a small pale-walled house set near the water.
must_preserve: dark pine silhouettes with individual needle clusters
rounded boulder washes and stippled rock shadows
small roof and wall geometry of the house
fine shoreline grasses and reeds
soft water edge around the islet

motifs.name: middle_water_boats
motifs.description: Isolate the open middle river surface with several tiny boats, fishermen silhouettes, faint ripples, and sparse shoreline grasses.
must_preserve: miniature boat outlines with curved hulls
tiny standing or seated figure strokes
very light ripple lines in open water
subtle blank-water spacing
small reeds and shore tufts at the edges

motifs.name: right_bank_village_under_willows
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right riverbank village: clustered tiled roofs partly hidden by willows, a tall leaning tree, fence lines, shrubs, and rocky bank.
must_preserve: precise tiled roof angles and eaves
fine willow branch tracery
tall leaning tree trunk with dark bark strokes
short fence and garden-line details
pink and ochre color accents on houses and blossoms

motifs.name: lower_bridge_and_pond
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left pond crossing with a low arched bridge, flanking banks, sparse flowering shrubs, water margins, and dark rock clusters.
must_preserve: simple arched bridge outline and deck lines
pale water wash around the bridge
low bank contours and grass strokes
small flowering branch accents
dark clustered rock texture at both banks

motifs.name: foreground_willow_rock_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground grove of slender willows and leafless trees rising from dark rocks and grasses near the lower center-right.
must_preserve: long flexible willow fronds
thin branching linework on bare trees
dark ink rock clusters at the roots
fine grass tufts and reed strokes
light green and pale blossom color accents

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
